sentences.en: The wording of the refusal was striking in its cynicism.
sentences.zh: 拒绝的话里充满了愤世嫉俗。

sentences.en: He gave a flat refusal to his mother's request.
sentences.zh: 他坚决地拒绝了母亲的要求。

sentences.en: What she wants to say just adds up to a refusal.
sentences.zh: 她想说的只是在拒绝罢了。

senses.zh: 拒绝；优先取舍权；推却；取舍权
